2 sprigs fresh thyme ~2 g each (standard modest weight for small herb sprig).
1 dried bay leaf ~0.5 g standard weight.
0.5 medium red bell pepper ~60 g edible portion (half of ~120 g typical pepper).
0.5 medium yellow bell pepper ~60 g edible portion (half of ~120 g typical pepper).
1 medium carrot chopped ~60 g (standard edible weight after peeling).
1 scotch bonnet chili ~5 g (typical small pepper weight); ~40 kcal/100g estimated from similar hot peppers as no direct value given.
1 medium lime ~65 g whole weight (edible juice/zest portion used for rubbing; matches given density).
